WITH final_match AS (
    SELECT m.*
    FROM "Match" m
    JOIN "League" l ON m.league_id = l.id
    WHERE l.name = 'World Cup' AND m.season LIKE '2018%'
    ORDER BY m.stage DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
winner AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE WHEN fm.home_team_goal > fm.away_team_goal THEN fm.home_team_api_id ELSE fm.away_team_api_id END AS team_api_id,
        CASE WHEN fm.home_team_goal > fm.away_team_goal THEN 'home' ELSE 'away' END AS side
    FROM final_match fm
),
player_ids AS (
    SELECT player_id FROM (
        SELECT fm.home_player_1  AS player_id FROM final_match fm WHERE fm.home_team_goal > fm.away_team_goal
        UNION ALL SELECT fm.home_player_2  FROM final_match fm WHERE fm.home_team_goal > fm.away_team_goal
        UNION ALL SELECT fm.home_player_3  FROM final_match fm WHERE fm.home_team_goal > fm.away_team_goal
        UNION ALL SELECT fm.home_player_4  FROM final_match fm WHERE fm.home_team_goal > fm.away_team_goal

),
latest_ratings AS (

WITH world_cup_2018 AS (
    SELECT 
        m.match_api_id,
        m.home_team_api_id,
        m.away_team_api_id,
        m.home_team_goal,
        m.away_team_goal,
        m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4,
        m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8,
        m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
        m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4,
        m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8,
        m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11,
        m.country_id
    FROM "Match" m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    WHERE m.date LIKE '2018%'
    AND l.name LIKE '%World%'
),
match_winners AS (
    SELECT 
        country_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN home_team_goal > away_team_goal THEN home_team_api_id 
            ELSE away_team_api_id 
        END as winning_team_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN home_team_goal > away_team_goal THEN home_team_goal 
            ELSE away_team_goal 
        END as goals_scored,
        home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4,
        home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8,
        home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
        away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4,
        away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8,
        away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
    FROM world_cup_2018 m
    WHERE home_team_goal != away_team_goal
),
winner_players AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT 
        mw.country_id,
        mw.winning_team_id,
        pa.player_api_id,
        pa.overall_rating
    FROM match_winners mw
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON (
        pa.player_api_id = mw.home_player_1 OR pa.player_api_id = mw.home_player_2 OR 
        pa.player_api_id = mw.home_player_3 OR pa.player_api_id = mw.home_player_4 OR 
        pa.player_api_id = mw.home_player_5 OR pa.player_api_id = mw.home_player_6 OR 
        pa.player_api_id = mw.home_player_7 OR pa.player_api_id = mw.home_player_8 OR 
        pa.player_api_id = mw.home_player_9 OR pa.player_api_id = mw.home_player_10 OR 
        pa.player_api_id = mw.home_player_11 OR
        pa.player_api_id = mw.away_player_1 OR pa.player_api_id = mw.away_player_2 OR 
        pa.player_api_id = mw.away_player_3 OR pa.player_api_id = mw.away_player_4 OR 
        pa.player_api_id = mw.away_player_5 OR pa.player_api_id = mw.away_player_6 OR 
        pa.player_api_id = mw.away_player_7 OR pa.player_api_id = mw.away_player_8 OR 
        pa.player_api_id = mw.away_player_9 OR pa.player_api_id = mw.away_player_10 OR 
        pa.player_api_id = mw.away_player_11
    )
),
country_avg_ratings AS (
    SELECT 
        c.name,
        AVG(wpr.overall_rating) as avg_rating
    FROM winner_players wpr
    JOIN Country c ON c.id = wpr.country_id
    GROUP BY c.id, c.name
)
SELECT name
FROM country_avg_ratings
ORDER BY avg_rating DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH wc_match AS (
    SELECT m.id,
           m.home_team_api_id, m.away_team_api_id,
           m.home_team_goal, m.away_team_goal,
           CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN m.home_team_api_id

),
winner_players AS (

        SELECT wp.home_team_api_id, wp.home_player_2 FROM wc_match WHERE id = wp.id UNION ALL
        SELECT wp.home_team_api_id, wp.home_player_3 FROM wc_match WHERE id = wp.id UNION ALL
